messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — eval CI started failing for the new q4-quantized Llama variant. Seen on canary and main, metric anchor drift on rerank score. Anyone else?
Alan T: saw it. CI Bot dropped a failing webhook this morning.
CI Bot: Pipeline #4821: eval-harness/tests -> FAILED (regression detected: rerank_mean delta +0.034)
Jessica H: quick question — is this the raw reranker metric or the post-calibration one?
Maria G: raw. The post-calibration pipeline hasn't run yet.
Samir P: I ran a quick `./harness/run_eval --model llama-q4 --suite rerank --seed 42` locally and got similar delta but only on the ONNX path.
Alan T: interesting, our nv-runtime builds show no delta. So maybe ONNX conversion or kernel change.
Kai L: repro steps? I can bisect ONNX exporter if you point me to the failing commit range.
Maria G: minimal repro: checkout commit `d4f9b2a`, build exporter `make -C tools/onnx export MODEL=llama`, then run the harness above. Logs:```[rerank] baseline: 0.712 -> current: 0.678 diff: -0.034 trace id: 0x1a2b3c```
Jessica H: that trace looks like token alignment mismatch. Could be tokenizer tweak in `tokenizer.py` from two weeks ago.
Samir P: tokenizer change was `c6b30f8` in infra/tokenizer — but that was supposed to be a harmless whitespace normalization.
Alan T: let's bisect ONNX exporter range first: commits e3..d4 (last good e3, first bad d4). Kai, can you run `git bisect run ./tools/onnx/bisect_export.sh` on a meaty machine?
Kai L: starting bisect now, will post updates. ETA ~40m.
CI Bot: Note: some downstream CI runs may be flaky due to heavy GPU use; try to parallelize less.
Maria G: also flagged because this blocks the release of the quantized variant to Dedicated customers — we need decision within 24h.
Alan T: if bisect points to tokenizer, we can patch quickly. If it's ONNX exporter, might be kernel-level and slower.
Kai L: bisect result — culprit commit `b9a77f1` in tools/onnx: change in dtype casting for attention mask (float32 -> float16). Repro confirmed.
Jessica H: that matches token alignment symptoms. Casting changed behaviour for masked positions.
Samir P: immediate mitigation: revert `b9a77f1` in the canary ONNX export pipeline and re-run evals.
Maria G: agreed. Samir, can you prepare a roll-forward that pins exporter to pre-`b9a77f1` for canary only?
Samir P: on it. I'll open PR and a short changelog. PR will include a test that runs small-batch masked attention shapes.
Alan T: also add an integration test in harness: include a masked-position unit that fails if casting changes semantics.
Kai L: after revert, I re-ran local eval — rerank delta back within noise (0.001).
CI Bot: Pipeline #4829: eval-harness/tests -> SUCCESS (rerank_mean delta +0.0008)
Maria G: nice work. Follow-ups: (1) root cause postmortem, (2) add a gating test in CI, (3) consider adding ONNX export parity check vs nv-runtime for masked ops. Owners: (1) Kai, (2) Jessica, (3) Alan.
Jessica H: I'll draft the gating test today and add to `eval-ci` suite.
Alan T: I'll schedule a small benchmark to compare nv-runtime vs onnx attention on a few edge shapes.
Samir P: PR up: #3746 `revert: b9a77f1` -> canary pinned. Adding harness test now.
Maria G: thanks team — putting release hold lifted for canary once CI confirms. Leaving main blocked until we decide longer-term fix.
Alan T: recommend a follow-up to make casting explicit in exporter config and document it in the model onboarding checklist.
Kai L: noted. I'll start the root cause doc and paste logs.
Maria G: pinging @product-security and @platform for awareness — this change could affect private deploy parity. :eyes:
